Instead select any Action card and take exactly 1 X-token, even if that card’s strength or upgrade is irrelevant. 3. Move the selected card to slot 1, shifting intervening cards as usual. 4. You cannot take this alternative if you already hold 5 X-tokens.', 'Turn Structure; X-TOKEN action.'),
'Q05':('1. Ignore movement beyond the last Break-track space. 2. The player who reaches it gets 1 X-token. 3. Finish the current turn; the break then happens for everyone. 4. After the break the token resets to its player-count start space and play continues clockwise with the next player.', 'The Break track; Break trigger from effects.'),
'Q06':('1. Both sides advance the Break token 2 spaces, with no money for this movement. 2. Cards I: either draw from the deck using its strength table (up to 3, with any listed discard), or at strength 5+ snap exactly one display card of choice regardless of reputation; snapping excludes deck draws. 3. Cards II: draw from deck and/or reputation-range display in any order using its table, or snap exactly one display card beginning at strength 3; snap has no reputation restriction and no deck draw. 4. Do not refill the display until the end of your turn. 5. Hand limit is not enforced during a turn; discard to it only at breaks (3 normally, 5 with hand-limit university).', 'CARDS action; Special Rules: Display timing and Hand size.'),
'Q07':('1. Reputation range includes the display folder corresponding to your Reputation space and every lower-numbered folder. 2. Reputation 10 and above requires upgraded Cards. 3. At 15, further reputation does not move the counter; gain 1 appeal per remaining reputation step. 4. You may not look through the discard pile during the game.', 'Reputation track and display.'),
'Q08':('1. Build I builds exactly one building, size no greater than strength; Build II builds any number of different buildings, total size no greater than strength, and never two identical buildings in the same action. 2. Pay 2 money per space, before placing each building. 3. First building must touch at least one map-border space; later buildings must touch an existing building by an edge. 4. Build only on empty spaces; cannot extend off map, overlap, or cover water/rock. Build-restricted icon spaces require Build II. 5. Each kiosk must be at least 3 spaces from every other kiosk. 6. Each pavilion immediately gives 1 appeal, once.', 'BUILD action, sides I and II and placement rules.'),
'Q09':('1. Build I permits standard enclosures, kiosk, pavilion, and one Petting Zoo. 2. Build II additionally permits Reptile House and Large Bird Aviary; each of the three special enclosure types is limited to one per zoo, though the general supply has four of each. 3. Build cannot create unique buildings; those enter only through Sponsor cards. 4. Covering every map space except water and rock immediately grants 7 appeal; Build II is needed to build on restricted-icon spaces, though other effects may also complete coverage.', 'BUILD action; full zoo map.'),
'Q10':('1. Bonuses gained earlier in an action, including money or workers, can be used in later steps; resolve items one at a time and pay each item before receiving its own benefits. 2. Thus previously gained money may fund a later building, animal, or association task if its cost is paid before that item’s reward. 3. Immediate effects resolve as triggered; “after finishing” effects wait until the entire action and card movement are complete. 4. For simultaneous effects, the owning player chooses their order.', 'X-tokens: bonuses gained earlier; animal effects; multiple simultaneous effects.'),
'Q11':('1. Meet all left-side conditions, pay the full cost, then house the animal legally; a matching-continent partner zoo discounts cost by 3 per continent icon printed on the animal (including a doubled icon). 2. Standard enclosure: an eligible animal alone in an empty enclosure of at least its required size; flip the entire tile to occupied. Petting Zoo animals must use Petting Zoo. 3. Reptiles and certain birds may instead use their indicated Reptile House/Aviary capacity; add one supply token per required space, never flip the special tile. 4. Meet water/rock adjacency for the chosen housing; count distinct adjacent terrain hexes, not touching edges. 5. Place the card, resolve ordinary effects immediately (including between animals), and defer after-finishing effects until the Animals action and card movement finish.', 'ANIMALS action, housing and effects.'),
'Q12':('1. Animals II allows animals from display folders in reputation range, at extra cost equal to folder number; display is not replenished until turn end. 2. At strength 5+, you may first gain 1 reputation at the very start, expanding range before selecting animals. 3. It permits animals with the upgrade-required condition.', 'ANIMALS action, Side II.'),
'Q13':('1. Only immediately when building a Reptile House or Large Bird Aviary may you move all suitable existing animals that fit, deciding separately per animal; the new building must satisfy terrain adjacency and have capacity. 2. Add the indicated number of supply player tokens to mark each animal’s occupied spaces; never flip the special enclosure. 3. For each animal, flip the smallest occupied standard enclosure meeting all its requirements, including terrain. 4. If none meets all, flip the smallest meeting size alone; if none meets size, flip none.', 'Moving existing animals into a newly built special enclosure.'),
'Q14':('1. Task strengths are reputation 2, partner zoo 3, university 4, conservation project work 5. 2. Side I performs exactly one task; side II performs one or more different tasks whose total value is at most action strength. 3. Each task needs active worker(s): one normally; if you already have one of your workers on that task, place two; if three are there you cannot do it before break. 4. Other players’ workers do not matter.', 'ASSOCIATION action.'),
'Q15':('1. Take partner zoos and universities from available tiles on the Association board and place them on the lowest empty matching map space; resolve covered-space bonus immediately. 2. A university also immediately grants its printed reputation, if any. 3. No duplicate university; partner zoos must be different continents, maximum four, and third/fourth require Association II. 4. Each partner reduces matching animal costs by 3 per continent icon and provides that continent icon. 5. Universities provide their printed research icons and benefits; the hand-limit university raises limit from 3 to 5, checked at breaks only.', 'Setup: Your zoo map and University tiles; ASSOCIATION task descriptions.'),
'Q16':('1. Conservation work may support a project already in play or play a Conservation Project from hand and support immediately; with Association II, qualifying display cards may be used at folder-number cost. 2. Fulfill a printed condition and choose an unoccupied reward level; no player may already have a token there, and normally you may support each project only once. 3. Take a player token from the left edge of your map and put it on the selected condition. 4. Gain project reward and activate the newly uncovered map bonus; resolve in either order, with recurring bonus paid now and at each later break. 5. New cards enter above the Association board, pushing others right; if over the player-count limit, discard the rightmost. Return its tokens to owners’ supplies; map bonuses remain active.', 'Conservation project work; support procedure and overflow.'),
'Q17':('1. Printed standard-enclosure size matches release category, not exact size: 2− accepts size 1 or 2; 3 accepts size 3; 4+ accepts size 4 or 5. 2. Lose only the animal’s printed appeal before conservation reward; discard it and lose its icons. Keep conservation, reputation, ability-generated appeal, and earlier effects. New release-project play grants 1 reputation; later support does not. 3. If animal could use special housing and its tokens can be removed, remove them; otherwise flip the smallest occupied standard meeting all requirements, or the smallest meeting size alone, or none if none meets size.', 'Release into the wild projects.'),
'Q18':('1. Sponsors I plays exactly one hand card if strength is at least its level and conditions are met. 2. Sponsors II plays one or more cards from hand and/or in-range display, paying each display folder number; strength +1 must cover total levels and upgrade-required conditions are permitted. 3. Resolve each card fully before next; defer after-finishing effects until action ends. 4. If choosing break movement instead, Sponsors I advances by strength and takes that much money even if fewer spaces remain; Sponsors II takes twice that money.', 'SPONSORS action.'),
'Q19':('1. Break order: discard to hand limit (3, or 5 with hand-limit university); remove Multiplier/Venom/Constriction tokens; recall workers and restock partner zoos/universities subject to availability; discard display folders 1–2, compact and refill; take income; reset Break token. 2. Kiosk earns 1 per adjacent unique building, special enclosure, occupied standard enclosure, or pavilion; empty standard enclosures do not count. 3. For display cards during income, resolve affected players clockwise starting with break initiator (or first affected clockwise); refill display after each player before next chooses.', 'Break procedure.'),
'Q20':('1. At conservation 2 choose Action upgrade or activate an additional worker; at 5 and 8 choose 5 money or an available Bonus tile; first player reaching 10 makes all players discard one Final Scoring card. 2. Check end at own turn end or during break when Appeal and Conservation counters meet/cross in same scoring area. If appeal is gained during another player’s turn, its owner waits until their own turn end or a break to check. 3. Own-turn trigger: finish that turn, then every other player takes one more; break trigger: all players take one more. 4. Each Final Scoring card can add at most 4 conservation. VP = Appeal minus lowest Appeal value in the scoring area containing your Conservation counter. Highest positive wins; tie goes to most supported projects, then shared victory.', 'Scoring/Victory; milestone rewards; end trigger; final scoring.'),
'Q21':('1. Shuffle 9 Bonus tiles and place face up random tiles on the four blank yellow spaces: two beside conservation 5 and two beside 8; do not use icon spaces. Return remaining five to box. 2. Component supply limits do not forbid legal play: use a suitable substitute if a component runs out, subject to explicit per-zoo and board-availability limits.', 'Global setup 2; Component supply.'),
'Q22':('1. For advanced maps, either take two random maps and choose one, or lay out player count +1 advanced maps and choose in reverse turn order; maps 1–8 are advanced. 2. Map A starts with an empty size-3 enclosure and a kiosk on indicated spaces; its printed kiosk counts as built.', 'Personal setup A.'),
'Q23':('1. Put seven player tokens on designated left-edge map spaces for conservation support; remaining tokens stay beside map. 2. Hire inactive workers from the lowest supply space upward. 3. Some maps award conservation when hiring the last worker.', 'Personal setup C2; Association worker supply.'),
'Q24':('1. Flip one chosen side-I Action card to side II in its current slot. 2. Side-II capabilities are usable from your next action. 3. It immediately counts as upgraded for conditions. 4. You cannot upgrade all five Action cards.', 'Upgrading Action cards.'),
'Q25':('1. Strength 1: draw 1/discard 1; strength 2: draw 1/discard 0; strength 3: draw 2/discard 1; strength 4: draw 2/discard 0; strength 5+: draw 3/discard 1. 2. Required discard can be a newly drawn card or one already in hand.', 'Cards draw tables.'),
'Q28':('1. Animal categories include bird, herbivore, predator, primate, reptile, bear, and Petting Zoo animal. 2. Bears and Petting Zoo animals count as categories unless explicitly excluded.', 'Animal categories; Base glossary.'),
'Q29':('1. Association II, and at least one association task in that same action, are required; donation needs no worker and at most one donation per Association action. 2. Pay the smallest amount still visible, cover it with a supply token, gain 1 conservation. 3. Ladder: 2, 5, 5, 7, 7, 10, 10, then repeatable 12; skip setup-blocked spaces. 4. After all but final are covered, each later donation costs 12, with no further token placed.', 'Donations — Association II only.'),
'Q30':('1. Count card upper-right icons; on animals and unique-building Sponsor cards also count upper-left water/rock requirements; count partner-zoo continent and university research icons. 2. Do not count left-side conditions or conservation-project icons; university reputation and hand-limit symbols are benefits, not zoo icons. 3. A card counts its own icons; doubled icons count twice. 4. Card text takes priority over general rules.', 'Counting icons in your zoo; Card text takes priority.'),
'Q31':('1. Count distinct adjacent water/rock hexes; several edges touching one hex count once, while a larger terrain region contributes each hex actually adjacent. 2. Decorative water/rock illustrations on tiles do not count as terrain spaces or requirements.', 'Counting icons in your zoo: terrain adjacency.'),
'Q32':('1. Playing a new Release into the Wild project grants its player 1 reputation; supporting an existing release project gives no such reputation. 2. Every Breeding Program project has the same condition at all three reward spaces; select any available reward space when condition is fulfilled.', 'Release into the wild; ALL Breeding Program project cards.'),
'Q33':('1. In X:Y, X is the condition and Y the reward. 2. A condition without a number or with “per” pays once per fulfillment. 3. A numbered threshold pays only once; with multiple thresholds, use the highest one met.', 'Base glossary: shared principles.'),
'Q34':('1. Connected space: uncovered and sharing an edge with a covered space. 2. Isolated: no adjacent covered space. 3. Border space: lacks a neighboring map hex on at least one of its six sides. 4. “Your zoo” includes your played cards, map, and personal supply. 5. “Any zoo” includes these for all players.', 'Base glossary: shared principles.'),
'Q35':('1. Place a unique building when playing its Sponsor, using matching tile, colored face up, freely rotated but not flipped; ordinary placement and terrain rules apply, with no size-based construction payment. 2. Unique buildings are not enclosures and cannot house animals or count as terrain. 3. If placement is impossible, the Sponsor card cannot be played.', 'Unique buildings.'),
'Q36':('1. For either named Action or Determination, finish Animals action and move Animals card first; then perform granted action and move its Action card to slot 1 afterward. 2. Named Action requires that specified action and cannot be replaced by X-token action. 3. Determination (Any Action) can choose any action, including X-token alternative.', 'Base animal ability clarifications: Action / Determination.'),
'Q37':('1. Assertion searches unused face-down base-project deck for chosen project; Dominance obtains its named project from that deck. 2. Dominance does nothing if that project is already in play. 3. Later play and support the obtained card through Association above the board, not in the setup base row below.', 'Assertion / Dominance.'),
'Q38':('1. Boost/Clever resolve after Animals and moving that card. 2. Clever puts chosen card in slot 1; cards formerly to its left shift right. 3. Boost puts named card in slot 1 or 5; moving to 5 shifts cards formerly to its right left.', 'Boost / Clever.'),
'Q39':('1. Venom, Hypnosis, Pilfering 1, each Pilfering 2 target, and Constriction require each affected zoo to have at least 5 appeal. 2. Playing animal appeal may be awarded before or after ability, so its newly gained appeal normally need not count for choosing targets. 3. Groups may use the alternative solo-marked text for interactive abilities without playing solo mode.', 'Interactive abilities shared eligibility; target reference; group alternative.'),
'Q40':('1. Affected other zoo puts one Constriction token on its slot-5 card if ahead on one track; if ahead on both appeal and conservation, put one on each of its slot-4 and slot-5 cards. 2. Never stack two Constriction tokens on one card; return duplicates. 3. Affected action loses 2 strength, including each multiplied execution; X-tokens can restore strength. 4. Return token after acting, or without effect at break.', 'Constriction — affected players and card ownership.'),
'Q41':('1. At effective strength zero or below, do not use the regular action as-is; spend enough X-tokens to reach at least 1, take the alternative X-token action, or leave the card until it is at least in slot 3. 2. If taking X-token alternative, it is unavailable at five held tokens.', 'Constriction — affected players and card ownership; X-TOKEN action.'),
'Q42':('1. Digging 2 permits up to two choices between its two options; decide again after each card, so choices can differ. 2. A discarded display card is replaced immediately, sliding higher folders down and drawing into folder 6.', 'Digging 2.'),
'Q43':('1. A flock animal can avoid flipping an enclosure if another herbivore in your zoo requires at least its printed standard-enclosure size. 2. The same qualifying herbivore can host any number of flock animals and need not itself be flock. 3. Without a qualifying herbivore, house flock animal normally; a later non-flock animal cannot join its enclosure. 4. On release, free an occupied enclosure under release/fallback procedure; exact original residents need not be tracked.', 'Flock Animal.'),
'Q44':('1. Full-throated activates the lowest remaining reserve worker, moving it onto notepad for immediate use. 2. Take any map conservation reward for hiring your last worker. 3. If all workers active, ability has no effect.', 'Full-throated.'),
'Q45':('1. If Hunter reveals no Animal card, discard all revealed cards.', 'Hunter X.'),
'Q46':('1. Choose among tied highest-appeal targets; if you select yourself, Hypnosis has no effect. 2. Copy only target card in slot 1, 2, or 3, using its owner’s upgraded/unupgraded side; use your own X-tokens. 3. Move copied card to slot 1 normally. 4. Venom and Constriction tokens on it affect you and are discarded afterward; its Multiplier cannot be used.', 'Hypnosis.'),
'Q49':('1. Place Multiplier on named Action card if reward names one; Bonus tile allows any card, including Animals. 2. Use it for two executions in succession at same base strength; move card only after both. 3. X-tokens boost one execution only; after-finishing effects wait until both executions complete. 4. A break triggered by first waits until whole turn finishes, so does not stop second. 5. Return used tokens to supply; clear unused tokens next break.', 'Multiplier.'),
'Q50':('1. Each additional Multiplier token adds one execution: two tokens allow up to three actions, not four. 2. Each execution may use different permitted options; a multiplied X-token alternative may take two X-tokens subject to cap, but cannot mix one X-token action with one regular action.', 'Multiplier: additional Multipliers; Choices.'),
'Q51':('1. Peacocking may place Large Bird Aviary before Build II; zoo must not already have one and a legal site must exist. 2. All other placement restrictions remain, including Build II for restricted-icon spaces. 3. Posturing uses ordinary placement rules including kiosk spacing, placing multiple buildings sequentially.', 'Peacocking; Posturing.'),
'Q52':('1. First Petting Zoo animal grants 3 appeal, second 6, third 9. 2. The single Petting Zoo holds at most three such animals. 3. They count as small animals.', 'Petting Zoo animal.'),
'Q53':('1. Acting player chooses target among tied leaders separately for each Pilfering 2 selection. 2. Highest-appeal target must have 5+ appeal; conservation target must have 5+ appeal and at least 1 conservation. If all have zero conservation, that part has no effect while high-appeal part still resolves. 3. If same zoo leads both, it can be selected twice. 4. Self-target selection has no effect; another Pilfering 2 selection still resolves.', 'Pilfering X.'),
'Q54':('1. Target chooses five money or a random hand-card draw; Final Scoring cards are never drawn. 2. With no hand cards, give five money; with less than five money, give a card. 3. With neither a card nor five money, give all current money, even zero. 4. Resolve repeated pilferings sequentially; target may choose differently each time.', 'Pilfering X.'),
'Q55':('1. Pouch-tucked cards have no remaining function; if animal is released, discard tucked cards too, retaining appeal already earned. 2. Sunbathing-sold cards go to discard pile.', 'Pouch X; Sunbathing X.'),
'Q56':('1. An extra Final Scoring card drawn before 10-conservation milestone joins the cards from which you discard one at that milestone. 2. At game end score every remaining card, each capped at 4 conservation.', 'Resistance.'),
'Q57':('1. Shuffle discard pile face down and draw randomly; make the stated selection, then return discard pile face up. Scavenging 3 draws three random cards, keeps one, and discards the others.', 'Scavenging.'),
'Q58':('1. Snapping takes exactly one display card regardless of reputation; it does not draw from deck. 2. Sponsor Magnet can take display Sponsors without reputation restriction; if none present, nothing happens. 3. Ordinary end-of-turn display refill applies.', 'Snapping; Sponsor Magnet.'),
'Q59':('1. Place Venom tokens on lowest-slot cards first (1, then 2, etc.), at most one per card; return duplicates. 2. Using marked card removes token and avoids all Venom fees that turn, including X-token alternative if below cap. 3. Pay 2 money at turn end only if no Venom token removed and at least one remains. If unable, undo turn and choose another action; cannot avoid fee by spending money. 4. Unused tokens clear at next break.', 'Venom X.'),
'Q63':('1. Veterinarian gives 2/5/10 money for 1/2/3 universities. 2. Conservation project support requires strength 4 rather than 5. 3. Final reward: 1 conservation for three universities.', '203 Veterinarian.'),
'Q66':('1. Medical Breakthrough gives 2 appeal per previously supported project, counted by missing left-map tokens. 2. At each break it gives 1 conservation.', '206 Medical Breakthrough.'),
'Q67':('1. Count different continent and animal-category icon types together, excluding research; each type once, even duplicates/doubled icons. 2. Owner gains 1 conservation per two types, rounded down. 3. Every other player gets 2 money per conservation point owner gains.', '207 Basic Research.'),
'Q68':('1. Science Library gives 1 appeal per research icon on play. 2. Whenever any player plays a research icon, Library owner gains 2 money. 3. Final reward is 1 conservation with five different animal categories.', '208 Science Library.'),
'Q70':('1. Expert on Americas gives 1 appeal per Americas icon on play. 2. Each Americas icon played permits a free kiosk under normal placement and spacing rules. 3. Final reward: 1 conservation with five or more kiosks.', '210 Expert on the Americas.'),
'Q72':('1. Expert on Australia gives 1 appeal per Australia icon on play. 2. For each Australia icon played, may tuck one hand card under Sponsor for 2 appeal. 3. Tucked cards have no further function.', '212 Expert on Australia.'),
'Q75':('1. When played, each card stores two tokens taken from own supply on its two printed top spaces. 2. When supporting a base project below Association board, return exactly one of this Sponsor’s tokens to supply as any one icon; cannot spend both on same project. 3. Base-origin cards played above board do not qualify. 4. Final reward: 1 conservation with five or more project supports, counted by missing map tokens.', '215 Global Breeding Program; 218 Breeding Program.'),
'Q77':('1. Each Build action can add one extra copy of a building built in that same action without extra strength. 2. Pay normal cost and obey placement; special enclosures still limited to one each; only one extra building allowed. 3. Final reward: 5 appeal with full map except water/rock.', '217 Engineer.'),
'Q78':('1. Gives 2 money per water/rock icon on play. 2. May cover water/rock spaces and ignore terrain requirements of animals and unique buildings; terrain need not be covered for full-map condition. 3. Covered terrain no longer counts for Hydrologist, Geologist, or Architectural Zoo. 4. Final reward: 2 appeal per water/rock icon pair, at most 3 pairs (6 appeal).', '219 Diversity Researcher.'),
'Q80':('1. Each actual placement bonus on border space triggers an additional choice of any uncovered placement bonus on map. 2. The extra bonus need not be on border. 3. Multiple triggers may choose same or different bonuses. 4. Final reward: 1 conservation when all building border spaces are covered, excluding water/rock.', '221 Archaeologist.'),
'Q82':('1. Migration Recording gives 1 X-token on play. 2. Each Release into the Wild support yields 1 extra conservation. 3. May repeatedly support same release project with different qualifying animals, but at most one token on that project per Association action. 4. Each token counts as separate project support for other effects.', '224 Migration Recording.'),
'Q83':('1. Quarantine Lab gives 1 X-token on play. 2. Immune to Venom, Constriction, Hypnosis, Pilfering; for Hypnosis/Pilfering ignore its counters and find next qualifying player. 3. Final reward: 1 conservation with all five continents.', '225 Quarantine Lab.'),
'Q85':('1. Permanently choose small or large, mark box with supply token, reveal deck cards until finding that animal type, keep it and discard others. 2. Cannot play opposite type. 3. Chosen small animals gain 2 extra appeal, chosen large gain 4; size-3 animals remain legal but gain no bonus.', '227 WAZA Special Assignment.'),
'Q86':('1. Gives 2 money per small animal on play. 2. An Animals action containing only small animals may play one extra small animal from hand at normal costs/rules. 3. Then add one small animal from display to hand regardless of reputation; may take it even if declined extra play. Mixed small and large prevents effect.', '228 WAZA Small Animals Program.'),
'Q90':('1. Hydrologist gives 1 appeal per water icon on play. 2. Each newly covered space adjacent to water earns 1 money, even multiple spaces of one building; a space beside multiple water hexes pays only once. 3. Final reward: 1 conservation if all water hexes connected (none isolated).', '241 Hydrologist.'),
'Q95':('1. Barred Owl Hut is a unique building Sponsor; place unique building. 2. Each bird icon played draws two deck cards, keeps one and discards the other.', '249 Barred Owl Hut.'),
'Q96':('1. Sea Turtle Tank unique building must be adjacent to water. 2. Each reptile icon played lets you sell up to two hand cards for 4 money each; discard sold cards.', '250 Sea Turtle Tank.'),
'Q98':('1. Each predator icon played triggers Hunter with draws equal to your total predator icons. 2. A card with two predator icons triggers two sequential Hunters, counting both new icons each time.', '252 Spotted Hyena Compound.'),
'Q99':('1. Place building with three supply tokens on its card. 2. Per herbivore icon played, may spend one token and pay money equal to a hand Sponsor’s level to play that Sponsor, meeting normal conditions. 3. Its own icon may trigger this when Stable is played. 4. Three uses total; card source is hand only.', '253 Okapi Stable.'),
'Q100':('1. Zoo School gives 1 reputation and 1 conservation. 2. Place building covering at least two border spaces. 3. Take one in-range display card or draw one deck card; simultaneous benefits may be resolved in chosen order.', '254 Zoo School.'),
'Q102':('1. Side Entrance unique building occupies two border spaces and need not touch existing building; other placement rules apply. 2. Later buildings may attach to it. 3. At break, it gives 2 money per adjacent building except empty standard enclosures; may stand beside kiosk. 4. It is a unique building, so adjacent kiosks count it for kiosk income. 5. Final reward: 5 appeal with full map excluding water/rock.', '257 Side Entrance.'),
'Q104':('1. Immediate appeal is 1 per connected uncovered building border space, never water/rock. 2. Final: 1 conservation per six contiguous empty building spaces; score groups separately, e.g. groups 13,6,3,2 yield 3 total. 3. Restricted spaces count even if Build not upgraded; terrain spaces excluded.', '260 Native Farm Animals.'),
'Q106':('1. Immediate money is 2 per different continent/animal-category icon, excluding research. 2. Each category/continent newly introduced grants 1 appeal and 2 money. 3. A newly played double identical icon gives novelty once.', '262 Explorer.'),
'Q107':('1. Gives free size-5 standard enclosure under ordinary placement rules. 2. When playing large animal, ignore one left-side condition, such as required icon or Animals upgrade; terrain cannot be ignored. 3. Stacks with Research Institute to ignore two conditions.', '263 WAZA Large Animal Program.'),
'Q112':('1. Gain 1 conservation per animal category where your zoo has more icons than player to your right. 2. If they have zero in a category, one of yours is enough. 3. Maximum 4 conservation.', 'Biodiverse Zoo (009).'),
'Q113':('1. Only standard enclosures adjacent to Observation Tower hex qualify, not merely another rock hex. 2. Special enclosures do not qualify. 3. Housing there gives the two appeal again after an earlier animal was released. 4. Tower is not a building for kiosk income.', 'Map 1, Observation Tower.'),
'Q114':('1. Standard enclosure touching Outdoor Area hex qualifies, not merely another water hex. 2. It counts as two spaces larger for all purposes after placement (e.g., physical size 2 treated as 4). 3. Cannot ignore for release or transfer. 4. No special-enclosure effect; Outdoor Area is not a building.', 'Map 2, Outdoor Areas.'),
'Q115':('1. A building on Harbor’s adjacent building space activates it; first building may start beside Harbor but need not. 2. Discard ability usable once per own turn, before/during/after action; not during breaks or others’ turns. 3. Harbor is not a building.', 'Map 4, Commercial Harbor.'),
'Q116':('1. Restaurant break income is 1 money per adjacent covered hex, not per building; empty enclosures qualify and each hex counts. 2. Restaurant is not a building and gives zero income to adjacent kiosks. 3. Its placement bonus grants one free Reptile House or one free Large Bird Aviary, choice of one, even before Build II; other placement restrictions remain.', 'Map 5, Park Restaurant.'),
'Q119':('1. Cover H spaces with buildings under ordinary placement rules; each covered H reveals deck cards until Sponsor appears, keep it and discard others. 2. H is not placement bonus and does not trigger Archaeologist. 3. Once all three covered, every Sponsor level is one lower. 4. Third/fourth bonus partner zoos still require Association II; bonus buildings still require Build II for restricted spaces.', 'Map 8, Hollywood Hills.'),
'Q123':('1. Pay money equal to Sponsor level and meet normal play conditions. 2. Use hand only, even with Sponsors II; no display card. 3. Sponsors Action card stays in current slot and does not move.', 'Official base FAQ: paid-Sponsor effect.'),
'Q124':('1. Appeal cannot exceed 113; excess gains are lost. 2. Conservation cannot exceed 41; excess gains are lost.', 'Official base FAQ: Appeal and conservation limits.'),
'Q125':('1. Venom affects every other zoo with higher appeal and at least 5 appeal. 2. Hypnosis targets a highest-appeal zoo with 5+ (acting player chooses ties), and copies slot 1, 2, or 3. 3. Pilfering 1 targets highest appeal with 5+; Pilfering 2 separately targets highest appeal and most conservation, each 5+ (conservation target also at least 1 conservation); actor chooses ties. 4. Constriction affects every other 5+ appeal zoo ahead on appeal and/or conservation; one track lead gets token on slot 5, both gets tokens on slots 4 and 5.', 'Interactive target reference.'),
'Q127':('1. Animal partner-zoo condition means partner zoo from its continent; Sponsor partner condition allows any continent. 2. Maximum-25 appeal condition permits play only at 25 or below; marker is reminder, not general cap. 3. Minimum reputation requires at least printed value. 4. Minus-one-condition ignores one left-edge requirement only; all other conditions and terrain requirements remain.', 'Official base FAQ: conditions.'),
'Q133':('1. Each selection may either discard one display card and replenish it, or discard a hand card then draw one deck card. 2. Digging 2 allows up to two selections and may choose a different option each time.', 'Digging 2.'),
